title: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Predictable and reusable email verification codes in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.4,…
description: The Joomla vi-solutions Visforms extension versions 1.0.0 through 5.6.4 and 6.0.0 through 6.2.1 contain a vulnerability where email verification codes are predictable, reusable, and derived from the email address. These codes do not expire after use and can be guessed without limits, allowing attackers to bypass email verification.
